legal.confidentialiteChapeau: what we collect, why, and for how long.
legal.avertissementTitre: This text must be drafted and reviewed by a lawyer before any public launch.
legal.avertissementTexte: What follows describes the intended structure, not a final legal text.
legal.encartSignalerTexte: Use the dedicated form: every report is reviewed.

conditions.objetP1: DropLink gives sellers a space in which to create, for each of their orders, a private page reachable through an unguessable link. That page gathers the photos and videos uploaded by the seller together with the parcel's shipping status.
conditions.objetP2: DropLink never takes part in the transaction between a seller and their customer: no payment is processed, collected or facilitated by the service.
conditions.compteP1: Creating orders requires an account. Viewing a page as the recipient of a link requires none: the recipient is neither registered, nor identified, nor solicited.
conditions.compteP2: An order's link is immutable. The seller may revoke it at any time, which makes it permanently inoperative and generates a new one.
conditions.contenusP1: The seller remains solely responsible for the content they upload and warrants holding the necessary rights. Infringing or unlawful content, and content harming third-party rights, are prohibited.
conditions.contenusP2: DropLink acts as a host: the service exercises no prior control over uploaded content, and does not select it.
conditions.retraitP1: Anyone may report content they consider unlawful. Every report is reviewed, and the account concerned may be suspended as a precaution — its pages then immediately stop being served.
conditions.retraitP2: Suspension is reversible: reactivation restores the pages on the same links.
conditions.disponibiliteP1: The service is provided as is, during its validation phase, free of charge and without any availability commitment. Tracking information comes from carriers: we guarantee neither its accuracy nor its freshness.
conditions.disponibiliteLacune: LIABILITY LIMITATION CLAUSES TO BE DRAFTED
conditions.donneesP1: Data processing is described in the privacy policy. The recipient's name is free text entered by the seller; it constitutes neither an account nor an identifier.
conditions.resiliationP1: The seller may stop using the service at any time.
conditions.resiliationLacune: DATA DELETION TERMS AND RETENTION PERIOD TO BE SET
conditions.droitLacune: GOVERNING LAW AND COMPETENT JURISDICTION TO BE SET WITH THE LAWYER
conditions.retraitFormulaire: Reports are made using the form provided for that purpose.

confidentialite.collecteP1: For a seller: their email address, the name and settings of their shop, and the content they upload. For a recipient: nothing that identifies them. Viewing a page records a salted fingerprint of the IP address and browser, never the values themselves.
confidentialite.pasDeCompteP1: Viewing a page creates no account, asks for no address and installs no advertising tracker. The name shown on the page is free text entered by the seller: it designates no user of our service.
confidentialite.indexationP1: Order pages carry a no-index directive, appear in no gallery and are reachable through no internal search. No rich preview is produced for messaging apps: a preview would show the content to people who never open the link.
confidentialite.conservationP1: An order's content is kept for as long as the seller keeps it. Raw carrier responses are purged ninety days after the parcel's last movement. Administration records are retained and survive the deletion of the account concerned.
confidentialite.conservationLacune: RETENTION PERIOD AFTER ACCOUNT CLOSURE TO BE SET
confidentialite.droitsP1: Access, rectification, erasure, objection. Write to us at the contact address shown on the reporting page.
confidentialite.droitsLacune: DATA CONTROLLER AND CONTACT DETAILS TO BE SET
